exposure: Clinical risk factors for placental accreta spectrum (PAS)
Loss of the retroplacental clear space
outcome: Prediction of placental accreta spectrum (PAS) in patients with placenta previa (PP)
Diagnostic accuracy of clinical risk factors, ultrasound, and MRI in predicting PAS
finding: MRI is the best modality to predict PAS in patients with PP, with higher accuracy than clinical risk factors and ultrasound alone or in combination.
